import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style for the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for transaction types with hue for fraud
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
